about: The sequentia of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Let Christians offer praises to the Paschal Victim. The Lamb hath redeemed the sheep; Christ the innocent hath reconciled sinners to the Father. Death and life contended in a wondrous encounter; the Prince of life, Who died, reigneth alive. Tell us, Mary, what sawest thou upon the way? The sepulchre of the living Christ and the glory of Him risen. Angelic witnesses, the winding-sheet and the garments. Christ my hope is risen; He shall go before you into Galilee. We know that Christ is truly risen from the dead; do Thou, victorious King, have mercy on us. Amen. Alleluia.
